sites.title: Create the site list
sites.description: From a dealer CSV the studio picks a varied set of sites (only states with open aerial imagery, far enough apart, spread over all states). Sample files are in the repository JanisKre/dealership_dataset (OSM, ODbL).
sites.tooBig: The file is too large ({{size}} MB at most).
sites.countInvalid: Sites: a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
sites.columns: Required columns: {{columns}}. The list stays on this computer (data/, not in Git).
sites.started_one: {{count, number}} dealer read. The site list is being created in the background; then “Load tiles”.
sites.started_other: {{count, number}} dealers read. The site list is being created in the background; then “Load tiles”.

tools.suggestFirst: Compute first suggestions with the start weights
tools.needWeights: Download the start weights first (Training, Advanced).
tools.audit: Compute audit questions for finished sites
tools.sites: Create site list from a dealer CSV…
tools.harvest: Take over corrections from the app

overview.subtitle: Where every step stands and what to do next.
overview.runningText: Runs in the background. You can keep labelling or close the page.
overview.questionsText: Confirm suggestions and draw missing vehicles. After a batch, “Save & retrain”.
overview.auditText: Find missing or wrong labels in finished sites.
overview.notDoneText: No open questions left, but the tiles have not been closed with “Tile done” yet. Only whole sites go into training.
overview.compareText: Everything answered. Compare the last round with the installed model.
overview.firstText: Everything answered. With enough finished sites, start the first full training from the DOTA weights under “Training”.
overview.countError: Count error {{mae}} vehicles per site, bias {{bias}}
overview.shippingNone: The app ships no model yet.

label.sinceRound: New since round {{n}}: tiles {{tiles, number}} · whole sites {{sites, number}}. Only whole sites go into training.
label.sinceStart: New since the last training: tiles {{tiles, number}} · whole sites {{sites, number}}. Only whole sites go into training.
label.emptyAudit: No audit questions. They are created for finished sites via “Tools → Compute audit questions for finished sites”.
label.emptyNone: No open tiles. New suggestions come from “Tools → Recompute suggestions for open sites”.

editor.toolAddHint: One click places a vehicle, aligned like its neighbours
editor.toolDrawHint: Drag out a box with the mouse
editor.fit: Show the whole tile. Zoom with the mouse wheel, pan by dragging empty ground.
editor.askAudit: Is a vehicle label missing here?
editor.laterHint: Leave the question open and go to the next one
editor.laterLastHint: Leave the question open; “Tile done” counts it as no
editor.allYesHint: Accept all open suggestions on this tile as vehicles
editor.noticeReadOnly: This audit tile has already been merged. You can look at it, but no longer change it.
editor.noticeReload: The studio was restarted. Please reload the page; otherwise changes since the last save are lost.
editor.noticeOffline: The studio cannot be reached. Your changes stay here and are saved as soon as it runs again.
editor.noticeLocked: New suggestions are being computed. You can keep working; saving resumes automatically afterwards.
editor.finishedSuggestions_one: {{count, number}} unanswered suggestion saved as “no vehicle”.
editor.finishedSuggestions_other: {{count, number}} unanswered suggestions saved as “no vehicle”.
editor.finishedLabels_one: {{count, number}} unanswered label stays as it is.
editor.finishedLabels_other: {{count, number}} unanswered labels stay as they are.
editor.lastTile: That was the last tile in the list.
editor.lastTileHint: When enough sites are finished: “Save & retrain”.
editor.shortcutsNote: Shortcuts work when the tile, or nothing in particular, has focus. Every action also has a button.

keys.yes: Yes: the suggestion is a vehicle

training.subtitle: Training rounds, learning curves and the current dataset.
training.roundsText: Each round: dataset → fine-tuning from the last round → measurement → new suggestions. Nothing is installed automatically.
training.roundsEmpty: No round yet. You start rounds while labelling, with “Save & retrain”.
training.chartText: Detection quality on the validation sites during training.
training.valFixed: The validation sites stay fixed so that all rounds are comparable.
training.manualHint: Full training from the DOTA weights (1–2 hours), or resume an interrupted run.
training.name: Name
training.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 41 characters.
training.needSites: Needs at least {{min}} finished sites, so far {{finished}}.
training.needDataset: Build the dataset first (“Build dataset only”).
training.noBase: “Start training” needs DOTA start weights (yolo*-obb.pt), and there are none here yet.
training.baseConfirmText: Download {{model}} (about 20 MB) from Ultralytics on GitHub? This is the only step that downloads anything from the internet.
training.epochsInvalid: Epochs: a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
training.fewSites: Dataset and training need at least {{min}} finished sites (all tiles “done”), so far {{finished}}.
training.noDataset: Before the first training, build the dataset (“Build dataset only”).

models.subtitle: Measure and compare models, install one in the app and ship it with the app.
models.installText: Install {{run}} in the app with a default threshold of {{conf}}? The current model is backed up; restart the app afterwards.
models.shipText: The installed model goes out with the next app version. This changes desktop-app/src/shared/model-release.json.
models.installBlocked: Off in sandbox mode without TRAINING_APP_MODELS_DIR: this would replace the app’s real model.
models.shipSandbox: Off in sandbox mode: shipping changes desktop-app/src/shared/model-release.json in the repository.
models.shipNothing: No model installed yet. Install a measured model above first.
models.shipMismatch: The installed model does not match its manifest (SHA-256).
models.chartText_one: Mean absolute error of the vehicle count per site (MAE) with the app’s detection, {{count, number}} validation site. Differences below about one vehicle are noise.
models.chartText_other: Mean absolute error of the vehicle count per site (MAE) with the app’s detection, {{count, number}} validation sites. Differences below about one vehicle are noise.
models.chartTextAny: Mean absolute error of the vehicle count per site (MAE) with the app’s detection. Differences below about one vehicle are noise.
models.tableText: “Install” exports the model with the suggested threshold (smallest bias within the flat optimum) and backs up the current one.
models.colWithin10Hint: Share of sites whose count is off by 10% at most
models.edgeTitle: At the edge of the measured thresholds: the best result may lie outside.
models.footer: All values hold at the suggested threshold, which goes into the manifest on install. Training rounds are measured automatically.
models.edgeNote: “Edge”: the suggested threshold is the lowest or highest one measured; the best result may lie outside.
models.noModels: No trained model yet. Start the first training under “Training”.
